summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any containment check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes UPLOAD_DIR. Any client can read any file the server process can read. This exposes secrets, config files and source code. Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays under UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively use send_from_directory, which enforces that boundary.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.description: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. Debug mode enables the interactive Werkzeug debugger. Anyone on the network can reach the debugger and may run arbitrary code on the host. Error pages also leak source and environment details. Keep the 127.0.0.1 binding and read the debug flag from the environment, defaulting to off.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no covering test
findings.description: The change adds the download handler with a 404 path and a file-serving path. The repository contains no test that exercises either path. Regressions in path handling, including traversal guards, would go unnoticed. Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt.
